meta.title: Villa Mandara — Where time flows differently
meta.description: A premium villa among nature and herbs near Gorna Kovachitsa. Far from everything, close to yourself.

about.title: Stay until you feel at home.
about.body1: Here the days smell of herbs and silence. Mandara was made for those who want to stop — to breathe slowly and listen to nature.
about.body2: Far from everything, close to yourself. No rush, no noise — just you and the calm of the mountain.
about.closing: Stay until you feel at home.

rooms.subtitle: Explore every corner — from the pool to the sauna — and feel the atmosphere before you come.

pool.name: Pool
pool.description: An open-air pool bathed in sun — for slow mornings and long afternoons by the water, facing the mountain.

dining.name: Dining room
dining.description: A long table under soft light — where unhurried dinners and shared meals turn into memories.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Four rooms, each named after a moment of the day and its own herb — a quiet shelter made for restful sleep.

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.description: A fully equipped kitchen — for homemade breakfasts or a dinner prepared by your private chef.

kids.name: Kids corner
kids.description: A space of their own for the little ones — safe, bright and full of play, while the grown-ups unwind.

yard.name: Yard
yard.description: A green yard with a herb garden and shaded corners — a step from nature, far from the noise.

sauna.name: Sauna
sauna.description: The warmth of the sauna after a day in the mountains — a quiet ritual for body and mind.

experience.lead: Every experience at Mandara is made to measure — from herb walks and yoga in the silence, to dinners with a seasonal menu and slow afternoons by the pool. All shaped around the rhythm of the day and nature.
experience.footer: Villa Mandara offers private experiences by prior arrangement — a private chef, massages, workouts and more.

region.intro: Set in North-West Bulgaria, a short drive from some of the country's most famous and breathtaking landmarks — the Belogradchik Rocks, the Magura Cave and many more.

belogradchik.title: Belogradchik Rocks
belogradchik.body: A natural wonder of reddish rock formations, among the most beautiful landmarks in Bulgaria. The Kaleto fortress is built right into them — a sight that stays with you long after.

magura.title: Magura Cave
magura.body: One of the largest caves in Bulgaria, famous for its unique prehistoric wall paintings. Sparkling wine even matures in its underground halls — a rare blend of history, nature and taste.

radetzki.title: The Radetzky Steamship
radetzki.body: A full-scale replica of the historic steamship on which Hristo Botev and his band crossed the Danube in 1876. Today a museum on the water — a living link to one of the most memorable moments in Bulgarian history.

chiprovtsiMonastery.title: Chiprovtsi Monastery
chiprovtsiMonastery.meta: St. John of Rila · a thousand years
chiprovtsiMonastery.body: One of the oldest monasteries in Bulgaria, with over ten centuries of history and a deep bond with the Chiprovtsi Uprising. Secluded in the mountains, it is the perfect start to a quiet walk through the past.

chiprovtsi.title: Chiprovtsi
chiprovtsi.body: This small mountain town is famous for its hand-woven Chiprovtsi carpets — a craft passed down through generations. Along the quiet streets you can still feel the spirit of the old masters and the authentic Revival atmosphere.

montanensium.title: Montanensium Fortress
montanensium.body: An archaeological monument from Roman times, raised above the town of Montana. A walk among the ruins takes you centuries back — to the life of a Roman province.

klisura.title: Klisura Monastery
klisura.body: A working monastery nestled in a picturesque mountain setting among forests and streams. One of the calmest places in the region — for silence, clean air and a little rest for the soul.
